[by Claude Code]

## Motivation

Refresh the cookbook's interactive **Agentic Long-Context Deployment** sections (#42726, #43083) on GLM-5.2, DeepSeek-V4, DeepSeek-V4.1, Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next against the latest SemiAnalysis InferenceX AgentX submissions. The configurations are mirrored from SemiAnalysis submissions, as raw launch commands, each linked to the run that measured it.

## Source

[InferenceX](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX) `main` (`4f00011e`), with these open InferenceX PRs overlaid:

| PR | Page | Lane(s) | Pinned to |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#3890](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3890) GLM-5.2 NVFP4 B300 SGLang | GLM-5.2 | `glm5.2-fp4-b300-sglang-agentic-mtp` | [run 38021505485](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/38021505485) (`/use`), verified |
| [#3836](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3836) GLM-5.2 FP8 B300 SGLang | GLM-5.2 | `glm5.2-fp8-b300-sglang-agentic-mtp` | [run 37815475708](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/37815475708) (`/use`), verified |
| [#3817](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3817) DSV4 B300 Dynamo+SGLang | DeepSeek-V4 | `dsv4-fp4-b300-dynamo-sglang-agentic-agg`, `-disagg` | [run 37715955859](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/37715955859) (`/use`), verified |
| [#3701](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3701) DSV4 GB200 Dynamo+SGLang | DeepSeek-V4 | `dsv4-fp4-gb200-dynamo-sglang-agentic-disagg` | [run 37656460117](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/37656460117) (`/use`), verified |
| [#3606](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3606) DSV4 B300 SGLang | DeepSeek-V4 | `dsv4-fp4-b300-sglang-agentic-hicache-mtp` | no `/use` yet: in progress, PR head `5b394d39` |
| [#3860](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3860) DSV4.1 GB300 Dynamo+SGLang | DeepSeek-V4.1 | `dsv41flash-fp4-gb300-dynamo-sglang-agentic-disagg` | no `/use` yet: in progress, PR head `b2061c77` |
| [#3859](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3859) DSV4.1 GB300 SGLang | DeepSeek-V4.1 | `dsv41flash-fp4-gb300-sglang-agentic-dspark` | no `/use` yet: in progress, PR head `e182134f` |
| [#2978](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/2978) Qwen3.5 B300 Dynamo+SGLang | Qwen3.5 | `qwen3.5-fp4-b300-dynamo-sglang-agentic-pareto` | [run 34548026742](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/34548026742) (`/reuse-sweep-run`), verified |

A lane from a PR without an authorized `/use` run is rendered at the PR head and labeled "In progress in SA InferenceX AgentX". It switches to the measured run on the next sync after the `/use` comment or the merge. Four overlays from #43083 (InferenceX [#3816](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3816), [#3840](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3840), [#3782](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3782), [#3744](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3744)) have since merged into InferenceX `main` and are now mirrored from there, at their dashboard runs.

## What this PR does

| Page | Lanes | Deployments | Points | Hardware |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GLM-5.2 | 15 | 25 | 57 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |
| DeepSeek-V4 | 12 | 26 | 75 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |
| DeepSeek-V4.1 | 9 | 25 | 88 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200, H100 |
| Qwen3.5 | 19 | 50 | 221 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200, H100 |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | 4 | 4 | 22 | GB300, B300, B200, H200 |

Only the generated data files and `_agentx.jsx` change; the page text, Deployment panels and Playgrounds are untouched. Rendered commands change only for these lanes:

- **GLM-5.2 NVFP4 B300 ([InferenceX #3890](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3890)).** c1/c4/c8/c20 now use 5 EAGLE steps (6 draft tokens) and become their own deployment, "Agg TP8 · MTP 5-1-6". c12–c48 keep 3 steps ("Agg TP8 · MTP 3-1-4").
- **DeepSeek-V4.1 GB300 SGLang ([InferenceX #3859](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3859)).** All of this lane's deployments move to the `nightly-dev-cu13-20261012-e6072935` image. TP4 c1 and TP2 c8–c32 are retuned, and c64/c128 move from TP2 to a new "Agg DEP2" deployment behind the SGLang router. The new `SGLANG_NUMA_BIND_V2=0` env var (TP2 c8/c16, DEP2) is mirrored as submitted.
- **DeepSeek-V4.1 GB300 Dynamo disaggregated ([InferenceX #3860](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3860)).** Adds five shapes (1P3D, 2P2D, 2P3D, 2P4D, 2P5D). Every worker gets `SGLANG_DSPARK_FOLDED_SAMPLING=2`. 2P1D's router session-affinity TTL goes from 1 s to 3600 s and its `--mem-fraction-static` from 0.85 to 0.8. The lane shows as in progress until [InferenceX #3860](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3860) has a measured run.

Status-only changes (the commands are byte-identical to `main`):

- Verified: Qwen3.5 FP8 GB300 midcurve, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next GB300 and DeepSeek-V4.1 B300 (merged).
- Verified at their `/use` runs: DeepSeek-V4 GB200 disaggregated ([InferenceX #3701](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3701)) and GLM-5.2 FP8 B300 c12 ([InferenceX #3836](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3836)).

**HiCache donor for DeepSeek-V4.1.** Every DeepSeek-V4.1 deployment's derived HiCache variant borrows its flags from `dsv41flash-fp4-gb300-dynamo-sglang-agentic-disagg`. Only measured lanes donate KV settings, and [InferenceX #3860](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3860)'s revision of that lane has no measured run yet. So the lane's measured `main` version ([InferenceX #3598](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3598)'s run) keeps donating, used only as a fallback where no displayed measured lane can donate. Every derived HiCache command on the page stays byte-identical to `main`; the per-deployment note now reads "...launch on InferenceX main".

**Component (`_agentx.jsx`), three small changes:**

- A point's own measured KV tier is always selectable. Before, the KV row enabled only the tiers the deployment could derive, so a point measured with a tier that had no donor showed its "as measured" chip disabled. This sync hit that case before the donor fallback above was added; no point on the current pages is affected.
- A disabled KV chip's sub-label reads "not available"; the tooltip still gives the reason. It used to say "not available for this image", which was wrong for HiCache disabled for lack of a verified donor (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next B300, B200 and H200).
- The derived-HiCache note adds "on InferenceX main" when the donor is the measured `main` version of a lane that an open PR replaces.

## How the commands are produced

The pipeline and rules are the same as in #42726 / #43083. Each lane is rendered at the exact commit of the run that produced its dashboard data or, for an open PR, the run named by its authorized `/use` comment (the PR head when there is none). SA-only settings are removed: the benchmark harness, cluster paths and caches, telemetry, and InferenceX's synthetic speculative acceptance (disclosed per deployment). Placeholders replace IPs, ports and NICs. Router and KV-offload variants that were not run are derived and labeled "Derived — not run".

- **Recipe-only overlays.** [InferenceX #3890](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3890) changes only the lane's srt recipe; its config entry is unchanged apart from comments. An open PR now also claims a lane whose recipe file it changes.
- **Not mirrored.** `qwen3.5-fp8-h100-sglang-agentic` (H100 without MTP) has never produced dashboard data, so there is no run to pin it to.
- **Images.** [InferenceX #3859](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/3859) pins `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20261012-e6072935@sha256:b5c48869…` (multi-arch). Pruned nightly tags are flagged on the page as before.

The data files are generated; please review the component changes rather than the JSON.

## Validation

- `mint validate` (strict build) and `mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects` pass; `node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs` passes; `pre-commit run --all-files` passes.
- Headless-browser click-through under `mint dev` of every hardware / checkpoint / deployment / concurrency / KV tier / router combination on all five pages (2,358 command sets: GLM-5.2 282, DeepSeek-V4 424, DeepSeek-V4.1 528, Qwen3.5 1,048, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 76), opening every tab. The rendered commands match the expected text exactly. For every deployment, a non-default selection's "Copy link" URL was reopened in a fresh tab and restored the same selection and tab (130 links).
- The Deployment-panel footer link still appears on GLM-5.2, DeepSeek-V4, DeepSeek-V4.1 and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and scrolls to the section; Qwen3.5's anchor sits directly above the explorer; pages that use the Deployment panel without the prop still show no link.
- The component's decoder and KV-tier transform, run through Node, reproduce the Python-generated commands for all 2,358 combinations, including every point's measured tier. Every KV-cache flag in a shown command exists in the SGLang commit of that deployment's image (188 image/flag pairs).
- Compared with `main`, every deployment outside the three changed lanes above renders byte-identical commands on all five pages, including the derived router and KV-offload variants.
- Single-node commands from bash launchers were accepted only where the dry run of the pinned launcher reproduced the server command in the run's job log (237 points).
- Every submitted and derived `sglang.launch_server`, `dynamo.sglang`, `sglang_router.launch_router` and `dynamo.frontend` command (1,957 distinct, across 28 images) parses with the argument parsers of its own submission image (CPU only). The 133 commands new in this PR were parsed now, each in its own image; the rest are identical to commands parsed for #42726 / #43083.

No serving or benchmark runs were performed for this PR; the numbers live in the linked SemiAnalysis runs. SGLang CI was not triggered.
